description: This file contains SCSS/SASS mixins related to grid layout, including container, row, column, and offset mixins used for responsive grid structures in CSS.

methods.name: make-container
methods.description: Creates a container with specified gutter spacing and centered margins.

methods.name: make-container-max-widths
methods.description: Defines maximum container widths at different breakpoints using media queries.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a flex container for grid rows with wrapping and gutter management.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares column elements with relative positioning and padding.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines a flexible column with specified size and maximum width based on total columns.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Offsets a column by a specified number of grid columns.
